hero.status: Trailhead · ML Engineer at Intesa Sanpaolo
hero.title: Find the best route. Adapt when conditions change.
hero.lede: I build end-to-end ML systems that turn difficult, real-world problems into workable solutions. The interesting work sits between research and production: taking an idea from the paper, finding what breaks in practice, and building something robust enough to rely on.
ascent.title: The ascent so far · 2020 to present
routes.title: Routes completed
eorc.title: EORC Energy Optimization Platform
eorc.problem: Energy systems have to plan capacity while demand and supply stay uncertain.
eorc.approach: A platform that converts stochastic demand and supply scenarios into multi-stage capacity-planning decisions. I own the architecture end to end, across optimization, backend and data visualization.
flood.title: FloodNet Image Segmentation
flood.problem: Identify flooded areas in drone imagery captured after Hurricane Harvey.
flood.approach: Trained and compared semantic segmentation models: U-Net, SegNet and DeepLab.
food.title: Fine-Grained Food Classification
food.problem: Classify food images across fine-grained categories, including degraded inputs.
food.approach: A CNN + KNN classifier with GAN-based restoration for degraded images and an object-proposal network.
food.statLabel: classes, with accuracy consistent across varied input quality

notes.title: Field notes
pub.title: Dynamic User Profiling for Personalized Tourism Recommendations Using Reinforcement Learning Models ↗
pub.authors: Ferrario, T., Fersini, E., Messina, E., Sormani, G.
pub.abstract: Proposes two reinforcement learning models for dynamic user profiling, a Hierarchical RL model with Matrix Factorization and a Double Deep Q-Network, to improve Point of Interest recommendations as users' interests change. The HRL model works well for users with extensive interaction histories, while the DDQN model suits new or less active users.

award.text: Proposed and prototyped a pipeline that turns a floor plan into a 3D model of the house, then uses generative AI to decorate each room to the occupants’ tastes.

summit.closing: Find the best route, adapt when the conditions change, and check the gear before heading into difficult terrain. Good engineering, much like good hiking, is mostly about being prepared for the unexpected.
